content.title: How to watch Santa Clara vs. Kentucky men’s basketball: First Round TV channel and streaming options for March 20
content.text: A first-round NCAA Tournament matchup will see the 10th-seeded Santa Clara Broncos (26-8) play against the No. 7 seed Kentucky Wildcats (21-13) on Friday at Enterprise Center. The contest begins at 12:15 p.m. ET, on CBS.How to watch Santa Clara Broncos vs. Kentucky Wildcats Venue: Enterprise Center Time: 12:15 p.m. ET Streaming: Fubo (Stream now) TV: CBS Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. Santa Clara vs. Kentucky odds Spread: Kentucky -2.5 (-121), Santa Clara +2.5 (-105) Favorite Moneyline: Kentucky -156 Underdog Moneyline: Santa Clara +126 Total: 157 Total Over Odds: -113 Total Under Odds: -113 Odds provided by BetMGM.Stats to know Kentucky averages 80.8 points per game (70th in college basketball) while allowing 73.8 per contest (178th in college basketball). It has a +236 scoring differential overall and outscores opponents by 7.0 points per game. Kentucky hits 8.1 three-pointers per game (150th in college basketball) at a 34.1% rate (176th in college basketball), compared to the 7.4 its opponents make while shooting 31.6% from beyond the arc. Santa Clara’s +354 scoring differential (outscoring opponents by 10.5 points per game) is a result of putting up 82.9 points per game (37th in college basketball) while allowing 72.4 per outing (132nd in college basketball). Santa Clara connects on 10.1 three-pointers per game (29th in college basketball), 3.1 more than its opponents. It shoots 34.6% from beyond the arc (151st in college basketball), and its opponents are shooting 32.7%.
